correctness.rationale: The exact PGL2(7) action on quartic double-cover equations is derived from variable substitution and fourth-degree scaling, with character twists tracked. The complete 336-element action on 140 states, all 112896 group compositions, orbit stabilizers, and all genus-one character sums are independently checked from embedded code. The genus-three quotient is proved to have numerator (1+7T^2)^3 using exact F7/F49 point counts and the Weil eigenvalue bound; tame V4 quotient isogeny gives four distinct genus-five zeta polynomials. Transitivity gives at most four abstract classes and differing polynomials give at least four. No unproved infinite extrapolation.
